🛡 Level 1

Scripture Connect

Study a verse, then tap its words back in order before time runs out to equip a piece of your figure. Finish a whole chapter to unlock a themed bonus round, then move on to the next book of Scripture — a little faster with every level.

How to Play

3 Simple Steps

1. Memorize — a verse (Berean Standard Bible) appears. Read it closely, then tap "I'm Ready!" whenever you want to begin.

2. Recall — the words scatter, including the book, chapter, and verse. Tap them in the correct order before the timer runs out. A wrong tap costs time.

3. Equip — finishing a verse equips a piece of armor or grows a fruit. Complete a chapter and move to the next, a little faster each time.
